author: SA Editor Yoel Minkoff
title: According to research firm Gartner, global shipments of pers
text:
According to research firm Gartner, global shipments of personal computers fell 1.4% to 61.7M units during Q1, marking the 14th consecutive quarter of decline.
However, average selling prices continued to rise amid a smartphone deceleration, uncertainty in PC replacement demand and as component companies remained cautious about expanding production.
